units.title: HEALTH AND SAFETY IN NETWORK ADMINISTRATION

learning_outcomes.description: Implement Health and Safety Standards in Network Administration

performance_criteria.description: Identify common health and safety risks associated with network administration work environments (e.g., electrical hazards, equipment malfunctions).
Follow safety procedures for handling network devices and components such as routers, switches, and cables.
Ensure compliance with relevant workplace safety standards and regulations in network environments, including OSHA and local laws.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement Ergonomics and Safe Work Practices in Network Administration

performance_criteria.description: Apply ergonomic guidelines to workstation setup (e.g., chair, desk, monitor height) to prevent repetitive strain injuries.
Use proper lifting techniques when handling heavy network equipment or hardware.
Implement regular breaks and posture correction techniques to reduce the risk of physical strain and fatigue during network administration tasks.

learning_outcomes.description: Address Cybersecurity Health and Safety Risks

performance_criteria.description: Identify common cybersecurity threats, including malware, ransomware, and phishing, and implement safeguards to protect network systems.
Follow secure practices for handling sensitive network data and credentials (e.g., using strong passwords, secure encryption methods).
update network devices and software to minimize vulnerabilities that could compromise network security.
Present technical information related to network configurations, issues, and solutions clearly and concisely to non- technical stakeholders.
Use appropriate technical terminology when communicating with colleagues, clients, and other IT professionals.
Respond to queries from team members or users effectively and provide actionable information.

learning_outcomes.description: Develop Written Communication Skills for Network Administration

performance_criteria.description: Prepare detailed network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, and reports, in a clear and organized format.
Write clear and concise emails or reports to communicate network updates, maintenance schedules, and troubleshooting results.
Maintain and update network logs, incident reports, and change management documentation in compliance with organizational standards.

learning_outcomes.description: Utilize Digital Communication Tools for Effective Collaboration

performance_criteria.description: Use project management and communication tools (e.g., Slack, Microsoft Teams, Trello) to collaborate with team members on network projects and tasks.
Use remote communication tools (e.g., video conferencing, screen sharing) to troubleshoot network issues with colleagues or users.
Share network status updates and incident reports through digital platforms to ensure stakeholders are kept informed of ongoing network issues or changes.

learning_outcomes.description: Collaborate Effectively with Team Members on Network Projects

performance_criteria.description: participate in team meetings, contributing ideas, solutions, and feedback on network-related tasks or projects.
Share relevant information, network configurations, and troubleshooting steps with team members to ensure tasks are completed effectively.
Collaborate with team members to identify and resolve network issues quickly and efficiently, utilizing team resources and expertise.
Assign network administration tasks according to team members’ skills and strengths, ensuring optimal team efficiency.
Take responsibility for assigned network administration tasks, ensuring they are completed on time and to the required standard.
Provide guidance and support to team members as needed, ensuring tasks are well-executed and deadlines are met.

learning_outcomes.description: Resolve Conflicts and Maintain a Positive Team Dynamic

performance_criteria.description: Identify potential conflicts within the team and address them in a professional and constructive manner.
Mediate between team members when disagreements arise, ensuring that differing opinions are respected and solutions are found collaboratively.
Foster a positive team environment by encouraging open communication, trust, and mutual respect among team members.
Manage routers, ensuring the correct setup of IP addressing, routing protocols, and access control lists (ACLs).
Set up network switches, including VLANs, trunking, and port security, to ensure proper network segmentation and security.
Perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on routers and switches to resolve connectivity and configuration issues.
Monitor the performance of routers and switches, adjusting configurations as necessary to maintain optimal network performance.
Configure static and dynamic routing protocols (such as RIP, OSPF, and EIGRP) to enable efficient routing between network segments.
Implement route summarization, redistribution, and policy-based routing to optimize routing table size and efficiency.
Troubleshoot routing issues, ensuring that network traffic flows efficiently between multiple network segments.
Optimize routing performance using network analysis tools to ensure network reliability and minimize downtime.
Manage VLANs to segment network traffic and improve security and performance.
Set up inter-VLAN routing, ensuring proper communication between different VLANs as required.
Configure trunking protocols, including IEEE 802.1Q, to allow VLAN traffic to pass between switches.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to VLANs, such as VLAN misconfigurations or communication breakdowns.

learning_outcomes.description: Manage Network Firewalls and Security Settings

performance_criteria.description: Configure network firewalls to filter traffic based on IP addresses, ports, and protocols.
Implement security policies such as Access Control Lists (ACLs), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and VPN configurations to safeguard network infrastructure.
Analyze firewall logs to identify potential security threats or breaches.
Update firewall configurations to adapt to emerging threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring ongoing network security.
Utilize network analysis tools to identify bottlenecks, performance issues, or misconfigurations within the network.
Perform root cause analysis to identify issues related to routing, switching, VLANs, or firewalls and resolve them efficiently.
Optimize network performance by adjusting configurations based on troubleshooting findings, ensuring that the network is running at its best.
Implement network monitoring systems to proactively detect issues and optimize network configurations to avoid future disruptions.
Configure network firewalls to control inbound and outbound traffic based on security policies.
Implement Access Control Lists ACLs on firewalls to filter traffic based on IP addresses, ports, and protocols.
Monitor firewall logs for potential security breaches or unauthorized access attempts.
Update firewall rules and policies in response to emerging security threats or organizational changes.

learning_outcomes.description: Deploy Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS)

performance_criteria.description: Configure Intrusion Detection SystemsIDS to monitor network traffic for signs of suspicious activity or security breaches.
Set up Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) to automatically block malicious traffic and protect network assets.
Review IDS/IPS logs to identify potential vulnerabilities and security threats in the network.
Adjust IDS/IPS configurations to improve detection accuracy and minimize false positives or false negatives.
Configure site-to-site and remote access VPNs to enable secure communication between network segments or remote users.
Implement VPN encryption protocols such as IPSec and SSL to ensure secure transmission of data across the network.
Troubleshoot VPN connections to ensure continuous, secure access for remote users.
Update VPN configurations to meet security requirements and ensure compatibility with changing network environments.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply Security Policies and Access Control Mechanisms

performance_criteria.description: Develop access control policies based on user roles, ensuring proper authorization for network resources.
Configure role-based access control (RBAC) or mandatory access control (MAC) to restrict access to sensitive network resources.
Enforce network security policies through network access control systems (e.g., NAC) to manage devices connecting to the network.
Update security policies to adapt to new security challenges, user needs, and organizational changes.

learning_outcomes.description: Utilize Network Monitoring Tools for Performance Assessment

performance_criteria.description: Use network monitoring software (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios) to collect data on network traffic, bandwidth utilization, and device health.
Analyze monitoring data to identify performance bottlenecks or deviations from normal network performance.
Configure network monitoring tools to send alerts for performance degradation or potential issues in real-time.
Review network performance reports and provide recommendations for improving efficiency and throughput.

learning_outcomes.description: Diagnose Network Issues Using Troubleshooting Tools

performance_criteria.description: Use diagnostic tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and NetFlow to troubleshoot connectivity issues across the network.
Utilize Wireshark or similar packet analysis tools to capture and analyze network traffic for troubleshooting performance or security issues.
Interpret network logs and error messages to pinpoint the root cause of network disruptions or performance issues.
Perform diagnostic tests on network hardware (e.g., routers, switches, firewalls) to identify faulty devices or misconfigurations.
Implement techniques to optimize network traffic, including Quality of Service (QoS), load balancing, and bandwidth management.
Address network congestion issues by adjusting configurations, such as rerouting traffic, optimizing routing protocols, or upgrading network components.
Resolve issues with network latency by identifying the source of delays (e.g., hardware failure, routing inefficiencies, or traffic overload).
Implement solutions to address packet loss, jitter, and other network performance anomalies that affect end-user experience.

learning_outcomes.description: Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for Network Problems

performance_criteria.description: Apply systematic troubleshooting methodologies (e.g., OSI model, divide and conquer) to identify the underlying cause of complex network issues.
Utilize logs, diagnostic tools, and performance metrics to analyze patterns and recurring issues within the network infrastructure.
Implement corrective actions based on the root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences of the same problem.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement Proactive Network Maintenance and Monitoring Practices

performance_criteria.description: Set up regular network performance checks, including bandwidth monitoring, device health checks, and traffic analysis.
Implement automated monitoring systems to detect and address network issues before they impact users or services.
Establish a network maintenance schedule that includes routine software updates, hardware checks, and security patches.
Configure primary and secondary DNS servers to support name resolution for the network.
Implement DNS zone types (e.g., forward lookup, reverse lookup) and configure records (A, MX, CNAME, etc.) to meet organizational needs.
Monitor DNS server performance and troubleshoot name resolution issues.
Secure DNS servers by configuring Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC) to prevent cache poisoning and ensure data integrity.

learning_outcomes.description: Configure Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) Services

performance_criteria.description: Configure DHCP servers to assign IP addresses, default gateways, DNS servers, and other network settings to devices within a specified range.
Configure DHCP scopes, subnets, and reservations to ensure efficient IP address allocation.
Monitor DHCP server activity and address issues such as address conflicts or lease expiration.
Implement DHCP failover and high availability configurations to prevent service interruptions in case of DHCP server failures.
Configure site-to-site and remote access VPNs using protocols such as IPSec, SSL, and L2TP to enable secure communication.
Set up authentication methods for VPNs, including certificate-based, pre-shared keys, and multi-factor authentication.
Monitor VPN connections to ensure security and performance, and resolve connection issues as they arise.
Implement VPN encryption and tunnelling protocols to protect data transmission and prevent unauthorized access.

learning_outcomes.description: Manage Quality of Service (QoS) for Network Traffic Optimization

performance_criteria.description: Configure QoS policies on network devices (routers, switches) to prioritize traffic based on application requirements, such as VoIP, video, and business-critical apps.
Implement traffic shaping, bandwidth management, and congestion control mechanisms to optimize network performance.
Monitor QoS metrics and adjust policies to maintain high performance during periods of network congestion.
Troubleshoot QoS issues, such as latency, jitter, and packet loss, and optimize network performance to meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

learning_outcomes.description: Manage Service- Level Agreements (SLAs) for Network Services.

performance_criteria.description: Document SLAs for network services, including uptime, response time, and performance expectations for DNS, DHCP, VPN, and other critical services.
Implement monitoring systems to track SLA compliance and network service performance.
Report on SLA performance, identifying areas of improvement and making necessary adjustments to meet service goals.
Address SLA violations by investigating root causes, implementing corrective measures, and communicating resolutions to stakeholders.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Effective Leadership Skills in Network Administration

performance_criteria.description: Set clear objectives and performance expectations for the network administration team, aligning with organizational goals.
Motivate and guide team members to meet deadlines, troubleshoot complex network issues, and ensure the reliability of network services.
Provide constructive feedback to team members and foster a culture of continuous improvement and professional development.
Lead by example in maintaining professionalism, technical expertise, and a positive work environment.
Develop project plans for network upgrades, installations, or troubleshooting, clearly outlining timelines, resources, and deliverables.
Allocate resources effectively, including team members, tools, and budget, to meet project objectives.
Ensure project milestones are met on time by monitoring progress and addressing any roadblocks or delays.

learning_outcomes.description: Manage Network Security and Risk Mitigation Strategies

performance_criteria.description: Lead the development and implementation of network security policies and protocols to protect the network from external and internal threats.
Coordinate security audits and risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities and plan mitigation strategies.
Foster a proactive security culture within the network administration team, ensuring that security is embedded in all aspects of network design and maintenance.

learning_outcomes.description: Make Strategic Decisions to Improve Network Performance and Efficiency

performance_criteria.description: Analyze network performance data and identify areas for improvement in speed, bandwidth, and overall efficiency.
Implement network optimizations (e.g., hardware upgrades, routing adjustments, load balancing) to enhance performance and user experience.
Evaluate emerging technologies and trends in network administration, advising the organization on their potential benefits or risks.
Develop cost-effective strategies for network expansion, upgrades, and maintenance while considering the organization’s growth and resource allocation.
